title: Subject-Verb Agreement #1
statement: Identify the grammatically correct sentence:

options.text: Neither of the two candidate were qualified.
Neither of the two candidates are qualified.
Neither of the two candidates was qualified.
Neither of the two candidates were qualified.

explanation: "Neither" is a singular pronoun and requires the singular verb "was".
